target: Local Landing_Page source; live deployment was not updated.
method: Playwright browser-engine simulation with DOM text bounds, line rectangles, overflow/clipping and selected overlap checks; representative screenshots inspected.
externalRequests: Non-local HTTP(S) API and analytics requests were intercepted. Local image/font/module requests and blob/data resources were allowed. No production reservation, vote or survey records were created.
largeTextMethod: Root font-size: 200%, not whole-page zoom or operating-system text scaling.
limits: Not physical iPhone, Android, tablet or desktop testing. Viewport names represent screen sizes, not verified hardware profiles.
No KakaoTalk/Samsung Internet/Firefox or older engine-version coverage.
390x400 is a reduced-height viewport, not a real software-keyboard or safe-area test.
Fallback fonts come from the local macOS environment; Android/iOS system-font differences remain unverified.
Poster and fixed-layout demo/illustration text are excluded from general body-font overflow assertions. Demo phases and representative illustrations were inspected separately.
Geometry checks cover selected layout relationships and stable animation states; they cannot prove all pixel-level overlaps or intermediate transition frames are absent.

additionalFixedFindings.problem: Hero subtitle clipped; scroll hint overlaps subtitle or model credit.
additionalFixedFindings.fix: Mobile hero, hint and credit reserve space in normal document flow.

additionalFixedFindings.problem: No-wrap eyebrow exceeds narrow viewport or overlaps title.
additionalFixedFindings.fix: Introduction uses a wrapping flex column; illustration offsets are scoped inside a separate visual container.

additionalFixedFindings.problem: Gallery introduction overlaps its fixed-position CTA; narrow CTA grows beyond its reserved section height.
additionalFixedFindings.fix: CTA follows introduction in document flow; section height grows with its content.

additionalFixedFindings.problem: Long email and title widen the flex child, moving dialog text and controls outside the viewport.
additionalFixedFindings.fix: Flex child min-width: 0; long title and email may wrap.

additionalFixedFindings.trigger: Desktop reduced motion; normal scroll transition on mobile and desktop
additionalFixedFindings.problem: Reduced-motion desktop retains a negative story margin; during normal motion model credit shows behind story heading.
additionalFixedFindings.fix: Restore zero overlap after desktop media rules for reduced motion; make transition background opaque before story text begins.
additionalFixedFindings.verification: Reduced-motion section boundary assertion plus before/after normal-motion screenshots.
